refresh-interval.tooltip: How often the desklet re-fetches usage from the providers. There is also a Refresh button in the header.

layout.tooltip: Side by side: one column per provider. Stacked: the same cards one above the other, full width.

desklet-width.tooltip: Width of the desklet in pixels, split evenly between the provider columns. Cinnamon desklets are not drag-resizable.

claude-enabled.tooltip: Fetch Claude usage. Pro/Max plans are read from your `claude` login in ~/.claude (nothing to enter); an optional org admin key shows org-wide token reports instead.

claude-set-key.tooltip: Only for Anthropic organizations: stores an admin key (sk-ant-admin01-…) in the GNOME keyring. Plan users leave this empty.

claude-clear-key.tooltip: Deletes the stored Claude admin key from the keyring (the desklet falls back to your ~/.claude login).

codex-enabled.tooltip: Fetch Codex usage. ChatGPT plans are read from your `codex` login in ~/.codex (nothing to enter); an optional org admin key shows org-wide token reports instead.

codex-set-key.tooltip: Only for OpenAI organizations: stores an admin key (sk-admin-…) in the GNOME keyring. ChatGPT plan users leave this empty.

codex-clear-key.tooltip: Deletes the stored OpenAI admin key from the keyring (the desklet falls back to your ~/.codex login).

ollama-enabled.tooltip: Fetch Ollama cloud usage: request trend from /api/usage and the session/weekly quota (or monthly allowance) from /api/balance.

ollama-set-key.tooltip: Stores your ollama.com bearer key in the GNOME keyring.

ollama-clear-key.tooltip: Deletes the stored Ollama key from the keyring.
